learner: 18-feature linear softmax placement policy; no search, preview, or expert reference
algorithm: episodic REINFORCE; linear-softmax policy, learning rate 0.008, temperature 0.35, discount 0.99, causal mean-return baseline from completed earlier trajectories, advantage clipped to [-10,10]
credit_assignment: G_t = r_t + 0.99 G_(t+1); every action gradient is weighted by its future return minus the baseline from earlier trajectories
reward: 0.02 for each legal placement plus 1.0 for each simulator-cleared row
checkpoint_rule: Each declared checkpoint is a trajectory boundary and frozen deterministic evaluation point.
evaluation: 12 matched deterministic games per checkpoint, capped at 300 placements; 16 policy-independent diagnostic states
control: identical initial student receives the same 3000 indexed pieces and acts sequentially but receives zero parameter updates
success_criterion: Final RL mean placements must exceed initial by both 25% and 10 placements; final mean lines must be at least 25% above initial; final placements and lines must both exceed matched non-learning control.
rating: No rating will be reported because no independent richer-student ladder is calibrated.
expert_isolation: The expert is neither constructed nor called in train_exposure; training audit must record zero calls. It is invoked only after frozen student decisions for secondary diagnostics.
